title: 2025 AMC 10B Problem 1
statement: The instructions on a \(350\)-gram bag of coffee beans say that proper brewing of a large mug of pour-over coffee requires \(20\) grams of coffee beans. What is the greatest number of properly brewed large mugs of coffee that can be made from the coffee beans in that bag?

solutions.text: Each mug needs \(20\) grams, so we divide: \(\frac{350}{20} = 17.5.\) A half mug isn’t a mug, so round down. That leaves \(17.\) Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Each mug uses \(20\) grams, so divide the total mass by \(20\)
A partial mug does not count, so round \(\frac{350}{20}\) down to a whole number
